title: POSITION_EVENT model is frozen
decision: PositionEvent dataclass with 8 fields {actor,action,target,source,stance,modality,polarity,commitment} is the canonical model. CALL invariant: actor==AUTHOR AND modality IN (COMMITTED,PAST) AND polarity==AFFIRMED AND source IN (DIRECT,QUOTE_TWEET).
rationale: M008H validated: 787→477 calls (-39.4%), LIVE_CANARY 4/4. Model is semantically complete.
consequence: No mission may modify the CALL invariant or the PositionEvent dataclass without explicit CTO ADR superseding this one.

title: factory_capture FAILED is acceptable for spec_level=A
decision: When Claude Code (spec_level=A) commits directly during its session, factory_capture will return nothing-to-commit. This is classified BLOCKED but does not block mission ACCEPTED if tests pass.
rationale: Claude Code architecture: it commits continuously during sessions. factory_capture expects a diff after build_agent. Fix tracked as F005.
consequence: Mission receipt will show factory_capture=BLOCKED. QUALIFIED_RUNTIME_SUBJECT still advances after test_1 passes.

title: FinGPT/FinBERT are challengers only — do NOT replace M008H
decision: FinBERT and FinGPT are evaluated as challenger benchmarks only. The POSITION_EVENT model (M008H) is the primary classifier.
rationale: M008H is a rule-based semantic model with explicit interpretable invariants. LLM-based classifiers are less interpretable and may hallucinate classifications. Challenger evaluation keeps the option open without destabilizing the primary classifier.
consequence: Any mission that proposes replacing M008H with FinBERT/FinGPT requires explicit CTO ADR superseding this one.

title: No parallel writers on same repo before F006 (worktrees)
decision: Never launch two missions that write to the same git repo concurrently until F006 (worktree isolation) is ACCEPTED.
rationale: Without worktrees, concurrent writers cause git conflicts and interleaved commits that are impossible to attribute correctly.
consequence: X101+X102+X103 must run sequentially or wait for F006. XR01 can run concurrently with F-track (different repos).

title: test_full_corpus_extractor.py excluded from X-track test_cmd
decision: All X-track missions on twitter-radar-foundation-v2 must use --ignore=tests/test_full_corpus_extractor.py in their test_cmd until the 29 pre-existing failures are repaired.
rationale: These failures existed at M008H baseline and are not caused by X-track work. Including them causes VIOLATED verdicts that mask real issues.
consequence: X-track missions use: python3 -m pytest tests/ -v --tb=short --ignore=tests/test_full_corpus_extractor.py

title: CTO control plane before more product features
decision: After F001+X000C: launch CTO001/CTO002/CTO003 (persistent CTO state, event-driven loop, auto-reporter) before F002-F012 or X101-X103.
rationale: Adding more features while the CTO loop still requires human 'continue?' creates compounding dependency on Jocelyn as the CPU. Automating the CTO first gives leverage for everything else.
consequence: CTO001/CTO002/CTO003 are P0 missions in the factory queue.

decision: eventstudy library is BLOCKED_GPL — implement CAR on statsmodels/scipy instead
context: XR01 audit found eventstudy is GPL-3.0 (not MIT as stated in deep research spec). Also alpha-only: version 0.1a12, never 1.0. GPL-3.0 copyleft is incompatible with closed product without explicit license exception.
alternatives: (A) Implement CAR formula directly on statsmodels/scipy (BSD-3-Clause) — CAR = Σ(R_actual - E[R|market_model]), trivial with OLS
(B) Obtain GPL exception from eventstudy author
chosen: Option A — statsmodels CAR implementation, no eventstudy dependency
rationale: CAR formula is mathematically simple. OLS market model is available in statsmodels. Eliminates GPL risk permanently.
blocks_unblocked: XR03_ABNORMAL_RETURNS can proceed with statsmodels-based CAR
